Quarto Oggiaro - Vialba - Musocco — Milan, Italy

Average day Higher caution advised night

In detail

Repeatedly named in Milan press as one of the city's more problematic peripheral neighbourhoods, with recurring documented drug dealing and a major police operation (dozens of arrests, hundreds of kilograms of drugs seized, dismantling a local drug ring). Local reporting also documented dealing near Certosa station and organised theft near a nearby shopping centre. A residential/social-housing periphery area with genuine, persistent, recurring issues — though residents and reporters caution it isn't uniformly dangerous throughout. Essentially no tourist draw.
